name: Export NetConf Configuration
description: Export the AMF running configuration from the active ConfD master pod to a local XML file

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing netconf-0 and netconf-1

container.description: Container name when the NetConf pod has multiple containers

confd_dir.description: Directory containing run_cli.sh and the exported XML file

remote_config_file.description: Temporary XML filename created inside the ConfD directory

destination_config_file.description: Path of the local XML file receiving the exported configuration

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of an existing local destination file
